messages:
alex chen: Heads-up — we need to request capacity reservation + quota bump for ND A100v4 in eastus2 for the new training fleet.
priya shah: How many nodes are we requesting? what's the timeline?
alex chen: Targeting 8 GPUs initially (2 machines with 4x A100 80GB), aim to have capacity by next month for canary tests. Need quota increase for: Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4 (GPU quota) and regional vCPU/network limits.
mike riley: FYI reserved capacity is a different SKU, MS asks for reservation order + quota. I can prepare the cost estimate.
priya shah: Can you open the support ticket? include subscription id and expected start/end dates.
mike riley: Done — opened Azure SR: 22047893. Included details and attached ARM snippet. Sent to our TAM.
azure-tam: Thanks @mike riley, I've escalated SR 22047893 to the capacity team. They asked for VM family, exact counts, and expected sustained usage. Also requested a justification doc.
alex chen: Copy of the justification included in the SR: we specified model throughput targets and SLA needs. Also requested temporary quota while reservation processes (to avoid outage).
az-support-bot: [system] Support request updated: SR 22047893 — Assigned to CapacityOps. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/SupportRequestBlade/id/22047893
infra-oncall: Quick note — we should reserve IPs and increase NIC quotas too. Past incident showed NIC shortage when spinning nodes.
priya shah: Good catch. Adding NIC + Public IP quota bump in the request.
mike riley: Attached a CLI snippet to request quota via az support (for record):
```
az support create --problem-class Quota --subject "Request vCPU/GPU quota increase eastus2" --description "Requesting 8x A100 v4 GPUs, 100 vCPU, 50 NICs" --subscription 0000-aaaa-1111
```
alex chen: MS asked for a fallback plan — we proposed falling back to NCv3 family in westeurope if eastus2 can't meet timeline.
priya shah: Cost estimate looks like ~$22k/month for 2x ND96asr nodes w/ redundancy. Mike, please validate before we commit.
mike riley: will do. Also requested a temporary quota for the specific resource provider: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSets and network resources.
azure-tam: Update — CapacityOps requested expected start date and whether we can be flexible by region. They can fast-track if we accept cross-region fallback.
alex chen: Replying with flexible dates and fallback preference. Will prioritize eastus2 but accept westeurope as fallback.
az-support-bot: [system] SR 22047893 status changed to "Investigating" (1754322001)
priya shah: Thanks — once SR is approved, I'll create the reservation order and signal procurement.
infra-oncall: Keep infra runbook updated with reservation IDs and steps to attach quotas to subscription.
alex chen: I'll post the final reservation numbers here once procurement completes. :thumbsup:
